position_in_era.historical_role: A conscious attempt to write a Queen-style suite-form song: Radiohead explicitly cited Bohemian Rhapsody as the model for stitching multiple separate songs into one. Three movements (6:23 total): a 7/8 acoustic/electric guitar section; a manic hard-rock middle with Jonny Greenwood's buzzing lead guitar; a quiet closing section. Thom Yorke's voice and Greenwood's guitar are the dual protagonists across the shifting sections.

narrative_slots.production_facts: Recorded at St Catherine's Court, Bath (1996–1997). Produced by Nigel Godrich and Radiohead. Duration: 6:23. Composed from three separate fragments Thom Yorke had been developing. Jonny Greenwood's guitar work in the hard-rock second section includes a rapid descending run that is one of the song's most distinctive passages. Yorke has cited the process as analogous to what Mercury did on Bohemian Rhapsody.
narrative_slots.member_dynamics: Thom Yorke (vocal, acoustic guitar) and Jonny Greenwood (lead guitar, orchestral programming) as the primary dual protagonists. The song's three movements give each a different context: the opening is guitar-as-foundation with vocal above; the middle is guitar-as-aggressor with vocal in response; the closing is vocal alone with guitar providing texture.
narrative_slots.instrumentation_details: Yorke: vocal, acoustic guitar. Greenwood: lead electric guitar, ondes Martenot (on later album tracks). Colin Greenwood: bass. Ed O'Brien: guitar. Phil Selway: drums. The second section's guitar riff uses a tone and attack that creates a buzzing, non-melodic character — the guitar as disruptive protagonist rather than melodic voice.
narrative_slots.cultural_venue: OK Computer, released May 1997, defined the late 1990s art-rock trajectory. 'Paranoid Android' as the lead single announced that the album would not follow standard rock-song architecture. The song was named #2 in numerous end-of-decade polls.
narrative_slots.release_circumstances: Single released May 1997; album June 1997. The song's explicit Bohemian Rhapsody lineage (documented in multiple interviews) makes it a conscious downstream node in the aria_form_descent lineage.
